name: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
instructions: Pat pork chops dry and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Mix honey, garlic, soy sauce, and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear pork chops 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown.
Reduce heat to medium. Add butter and honey garlic sauce. Spoon sauce over chops.
Cook 3-5 more minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Rest 3 minutes. Spoon sauce over top and garnish with parsley.

substitutions.dairy_free: Replace butter with olive oil or dairy-free butter.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use tamari instead of soy sauce.
substitutions.low_carb: Reduce honey to 1 tbsp or use a sugar-free alternative.
